regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. I have just read and noted your pathetic letter of the 19th and thank you for same -- having enrolled you for your balky knee. I am inclosing a Sacred Heart (blessed) to place on your knee and I hope that our dear Lord may smile at you and cure the "old knee."
